name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Master agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work, covering deliverables, fees, personnel, IP ownership and acceptance.

coverPage.title: Professional Services Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Professional Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Professional Services Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the provider's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the customer's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.prompt: how long a statement of work runs, such as "until the deliverables are accepted".

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.prompt: any customer policies the provider's people must follow on site. Usually none.

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.prompt: the insurance the provider must carry, if any is required.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.prompt: where the provider's security policy can be read, such as a URL.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.prompt: the courts that hear disputes, such as "the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware".

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the most either party can be made to pay, such as "$100,000" or "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim carry a higher cap, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the higher cap that applies to Increased Claims, if there are any.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.prompt: which kinds of claim have no cap at all, if any. Usually none.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the provider indemnifies the customer against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.prompt: the third-party claims the customer indemnifies the provider against, beyond the standard ones. Usually none.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.prompt: any warranties beyond the standard terms. Usually none.

fields.label: DPA
fields.prompt: the data processing agreement between the parties, if they have one. Usually none.
